title: Resend a tote task command using the Tote Management API (Resend Tote Task)
summary: Use the Tote Management API function “Resend Tote Task” to resend a tote command when a tote encountered an error or failed to execute, and confirm the API response shows the resend was issued.
when_to_use: When a tote command previously encountered an error or failed to execute and you need to resend that command using the Tote Management API.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the “Resend Tote Task” function on the Totes Aveva API page and verify the API response indicates the resend action was issued.
access_or_tools_needed: Totes Aveva API page / “API Features for Tote Management”
Obeyba access (implied by the source login question)

access_required: Obeyba access to reach the Totes Aveva API page
system_preconditions: You are logged in to Obeyba (the source explicitly asks whether you are logged in).

visual_references.description: Totes Aveva API page showing the “API Features for Tote Management” function list including “Resend Tote Task”.

steps.title: Open the Tote Management API function list (Totes Aveva API page)
steps.purpose: Get to the “API Features for Tote Management” page where the “Resend Tote Task” function is available.
steps.instruction: Navigate to the “API Features for Tote Management” page on the Totes Aveva API screen.
steps.expected_result: The “API Features for Tote Management” function list is visible, including the function labeled “Resend Tote Task”.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see “Resend Tote Task” in the function list on the Totes Aveva API page.
steps.failure_condition: The “Resend Tote Task” function is not visible (e.g., you are not on the correct page or not logged in).

actions.label: Open API Features for Tote Management
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the “API Features for Tote Management” page on the Totes Aveva API screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot reach the Totes Aveva API page / function list, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Resend Tote Task" ... "Resends a command to a tote that encountered an error or failed to execute." (function list on the Totes Aveva API page)
OCR near this frame includes: "Are you logged in to Obeyba?"

steps.title: Select the “Resend Tote Task” function
steps.purpose: Choose the correct API function that performs the resend operation for a tote task.
steps.instruction: Locate and select the function labeled “Resend Tote Task” on the “API Features for Tote Management” page.
steps.expected_result: The “Resend Tote Task” function input area is available for use.
steps.healthy_condition: You can interact with the “Resend Tote Task” function (inputs are shown) after selecting it.
steps.failure_condition: Selecting “Resend Tote Task” does not reveal any input fields or the function cannot be used.

actions.label: Select Resend Tote Task
actions.exact_action: Locate the function labeled “Resend Tote Task”.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access the “Resend Tote Task” function inputs, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows the function list including: "Resend Tote Task".

steps.title: Resend the tote task command for the tote that errored/failed
steps.purpose: Trigger the resend operation so the tote command is reissued after an error or failed execution.
steps.instruction: Use “Resend Tote Task” to resend the command to the tote that encountered an error or failed to execute. Provide the required tote identifier if the UI prompts for it.
steps.expected_result: The API resend action is submitted for the specified tote (i.e., the UI shows a response after the resend request).
steps.healthy_condition: A response is displayed in the “Resend Tote Task” response area after submitting the resend request.
steps.failure_condition: No response is returned, or the resend action cannot be performed.

actions.label: Submit resend request
actions.exact_action: Use “Resend Tote Task” to resend the command to the tote that encountered an error or failed to execute (provide the required tote identifier if the UI prompts for it).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the resend action cannot be performed or no response is returned, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Resend Tote Task" ... "Resends a command to a tote that encountered an error or failed to execute."

steps.title: Verify the API response indicates the resend was issued
steps.purpose: Confirm the resend request was accepted/issued by checking the response shown by the API UI.
steps.instruction: Check the “Resend Tote Task” response area and record the response text/status shown by the UI.
steps.expected_result: The UI displays a response indicating the resend action was issued (response text/status is present).
steps.healthy_condition: A response is shown after submission and includes a clear status/text indicating the resend request result.
steps.failure_condition: No response is shown, or the response does not indicate the resend action was issued.

actions.label: Review response
actions.exact_action: Verify the API response indicates the resend action was issued (record the response text/status shown by the UI).

stop_or_escalate_if: If no response is returned, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate expected verification step: record the response text/status shown by the UI.

success_criteria: The “Resend Tote Task” function is used for the intended tote.
The UI shows an API response after the resend request.
The response indicates the resend action was issued.
healthy_conditions: “Resend Tote Task” is visible on the “API Features for Tote Management” page.
A response is displayed in the resend function’s response area after submitting the resend request.
failure_conditions: The “Resend Tote Task” function cannot be accessed.
The resend action cannot be performed.
No response is returned after attempting to resend.
escalation_guidance: If the resend action cannot be performed or no response is returned, stop and escalate (the source provides no further troubleshooting steps).
